name: Apple & Cinnamon Overnight Oats
description: Stir everything together before bed and breakfast is waiting in the fridge. Grated apple keeps the oats soft and sweet without much added sugar.
recipeIngredient: A handful of chopped toasted hazelnuts, to serve
recipeInstructions: Mix the oats, grated apple, milk, yoghurt, chia seeds, cinnamon and maple syrup in a bowl.
Divide between two jars or bowls, cover and chill for at least 8 hours, or overnight.
Loosen with a splash more milk if needed and scatter over the hazelnuts before eating.
